name: document_search
description: Semantic search inside ONE uploaded document file (working-folder file_id). Supported files: PDF (.pdf), Word (.docx/.doc), Excel (.xlsx/.xls/.csv), PowerPoint (.pptx/.ppt), and text/data (.txt/.md/.html/.json/.xml). The file is converted to organized markdown via MarkItDown, split into 300-word chunks, and embedded — scanned PDF pages with almost no text are transcribed by the vision model first. Call with the file_id inside the working folder (e.g. report.pdf), a query sentence to compare, and how many chunks to return (top_k, min 1). The file_id MUST be a supported type or the call is rejected — check the working-folder map or list first.

file_id.description: Path inside the working folder, e.g. report.pdf or docs/budget.xlsx. Must be a supported type.

query.description: Sentence to compare against the document chunks.

top_k.description: How many chunks to return. Default 3, minimum 1.
